title: Sequencer suite has no test for a solver step with no solver agent loaded
summary: The fallback of indigo_sequencer.loaded_solver_agent() (keep the stored name, fail through the missing-property path so the failure policy applies) had no test; solver_failures_recover keeps the stand-in loaded and passes on the previous code. Next: add a case with the solver stand-in renamed to a non-solver name.

resolution.evidence: Test 'solver step without solver recovers' added: stand-in renamed to a non-solver name, sync_center fails with 'There is no AGENT_PLATESOLVER_EXPOSURE on Astrometry Agent', the stored name is kept and the sequence continues at recovery point #1; suite 39/39 (verification.md).
